_comment: Small hand-built fixture for the ownership-index unit checks in tools/_verify-sunday-ff.cjs — NOT real production rosters (those are exercised for real in reconcile/rosters/*, which does carry a real dst_PIT key). This one exists purely to exercise the three key shapes the task calls out: a plain ESPN athlete id, dst_<ABBR> with the Sleeper-normalized abbreviation (WAS, never ESPN's WSH), and a slp_<sleeperId> player with no ESPN id at all, resolved by normalized name + NFL team against a game's box-score athletes.
